findings: Both tools require an explicit --original-id and compare it to the relevant accepted report or archive ready identity.

The literal table auditor replaces F14 constants with the hash-bound complete exact report and actual manifest cardinality; it additionally checks node-audit uniqueness and complete node-index coverage.

Every table leaf index, depth, parent, owner/axis/sign choice, round count, deduction count, terminal kind and positive exact reserve lower bound is still checked against exact proof bytes and report.
All individual proof payload hashes and total bound/terminal row occurrence accounting remain checked.

The archive auditor preserves part concatenation, every regular archive member hash, every source packet hash, native versus fresh portable report equality, input manifest, receipt and external-workspace prohibition checks.
The archive auditor compares all declared info counts to both exact reports and adds the tree identities nodes=1+4*proxy+2*angle+8*sat+2*difference and leaves=nodes-unions.
The retained prior_inputs==507 check binds the same accepted B16 prior dependency; it does not grant a new original-domain inference.
Only original-ID parameterization, count identities, output status labels and descriptions changed; no weighted arithmetic rule, physical premise, exact checker or accepted proof bytes changed.
scope_limitations: This is source review, not execution against a particular B580 packet or table.
The tools consume successful exact reports; they do not replace the native and fresh portable arithmetic replays.
No original-cell or mask credit is granted by this review.
